diagnostics.label: data effect mismatch
causes: A bare argument is `read`; `mut` and `take` must be written explicitly and match the parameter.

fixes.title: Write `value: take ...` at the call site.

diagnostics.summary: `fresh` expression must be bound locally before `mut` or `take` use.
diagnostics.label: fresh value requires local binding
causes: Direct fresh expressions can materialize as managed temporaries for `read`; `mut` and `take` require an explicit local owner.

fixes.title: Bind the value first, for example `local value = Buffer.

diagnostics.label: not a local value
causes: `buffer` is not a local binding and cannot be consumed with `take`.

fixes.title: Pass a local value with `take`, or use `read`/`mut` for managed values.
